posts.title: Too short for bad books
posts.description: Bookplate for the Załuski Library, designed by Jan Filipowicz. I realised a long time ago that life's too short for bad books. Reading for leisure is supposed to be fun, not a punitive chore, but somehow I've spent hours finishing books I hated. posts.title: Little, Big
posts.description: I first read Little, Big (John Crowley, 1981) in the nineties but didn't make it all the way through. As I recall, it was on the reading list for Changeling: the Dreaming (1st edition) but it was probably a bit too mature for me back then.
